description: This line plot compares the loss values of two models, "Vanilla" and "SepLLM", over a training duration measured in seconds. The x-axis, labeled "Training Time (s)", spans from 0 to 250,000 seconds on a linear scale, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", ranges from 2.40 to 2.75, also on a linear scale, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.05. The "Vanilla" model is represented by a purple line with diamond-shaped markers and a solid line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to about 2.50 by the end of the training period. The "SepLLM" model is represented by a red line with circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to about 2.50 by the end of training. A green dashed horizontal line at a loss value of 2.50 is drawn across the plot, and a green dashed vertical box highlights the region from approximately 200,000 to 250,000 seconds, with a label indicating a 1.26x multiplier, presumably referencing a performance metric related to the models' convergence.
